facts.fact: Nagasaki city tram offers mobile1day/24hour and paper1day passes, with different validity definitions; a calendar-day ticket is not automatically24hours.
facts.excerpt: When you purchase a-day use ticket, you can only use it during the date.
facts.location: Nagasaki city > One-day /24hour Pass for Nagasaki City Tram

facts.fact: The paper tram day pass is not sold on the tram and must be bought before boarding.
facts.excerpt: Ticket is not sold in the tram and you need to buy it before you get on.

facts.fact: Nagasaki Bus has its own1day/24hour options within designated areas, separate from the tram offer; a visitor should check operator and coverage.
facts.excerpt: within the designated area of Nagasaki City
